purpose: A five-step bilingual offline review route over existing evidence; presentation creates no new evidence or maturity.

steps.fallback: ../proposal.md#双轨京张前台空间总纲后台治理内核

zh.title: 看懂双轨，不把隐喻当建设
zh.question: 连续日常轨与间歇验证轨如何同时存在？
zh.answer: 日常轨先保证任何人都能步行、通勤、休憩、办事和离开；验证轨只在自愿、公告、限域且有责任人的时段旁侧出现。失败时退出验证轨，日常轨继续。
zh.alt: 双轨京张总体图：连续日常轨、间歇验证轨、三处换轨场、失败侧线、六类信号与公共时刻表。
zh.limit: 这是 G0 空间语法。验证轨不是连续占地、既建设施、铁路结论或审批边界。

en.title: Read the twin track without mistaking metaphor for construction
en.question: How can the continuous civic track and intermittent proof track coexist?
en.answer: The civic track first preserves walking, commuting, resting, service and exit for everyone. The proof track appears only as a voluntary, announced, bounded and accountable side layer. On failure, proof stops while the civic track continues.
en.alt: Twin-track master plan showing the continuous civic track, intermittent proof track, three switchyards, failure siding, six signals and public timetable.
en.limit: This is G0 spatial grammar. The proof track is not continuous occupation, built infrastructure, a railway conclusion or an approval boundary.

steps.fallback: ../proposal.md#三处重点区不是同一套构图

zh.title: 比较三种不可互换的公共空间原型
zh.question: 为什么三处不能机械复制？
zh.answer: 众智园用平行验证庭隔离设备并保留人工接管；原点社区以一街两院四节点支持无屏共学和逐点撤回；大钟寺以四象限步行、一厅一台守住通勤连续与人工服务。
zh.alt: 众智园、原点社区、大钟寺三种差异化公共空间原型总图。
zh.limit: 体量、构件与位置均为概念类型；尺寸、材料、连接、专项核验、消防、铁路保护与市政结论仍 unknown。

en.title: Compare three non-interchangeable public-space prototypes
en.question: Why can the three sites not be copied mechanically?
en.answer: Zhongzhiyuan isolates equipment in a parallel proof court with staffed takeover; Origin uses one street, two courts and four individually withdrawable screen-free nodes; Dazhongsi protects four-quadrant walking, one hall and one staffed desk for uninterrupted commuting.
en.alt: Three differentiated public-space prototypes at Zhongzhiyuan, Origin Community and Dazhongsi.
en.limit: Massing, components and locations are conceptual types. Dimensions, materials, connections, specialist checks, fire, railway-protection and municipal conclusions remain unknown.

zh.title: 先完成一个不依赖 AI 的普通任务
zh.question: 不注册、不扫码、不使用 AI，公众能否完成同一任务？
zh.answer: 可以。无屏入口、连续非 AI／无障碍意图路径、人工站房、纸面或口头说明和清晰离开路径构成完整主路径；AI 只作为旁侧可选叠层。
zh.alt: 三联合成概念图：普通居民、儿童、通勤者和工作人员使用三处空间，验证活动始终位于连续日常路径旁侧。
zh.limit: 这是合成概念图，不是现场照片、确认视点、无障碍合规结果、运营证据或人员承诺。

en.title: Complete an ordinary task without AI first
en.question: Can the public complete the same task without registration, scanning or AI?
en.answer: Yes. A screen-free entrance, continuous non-AI and accessibility-intent route, staffed station, paper or spoken explanation, and legible exit form the complete primary path. AI remains an optional side overlay.
en.alt: Synthetic triptych of residents, children, commuters and staff using the three sites while proof activity stays beside continuous ordinary routes.
en.limit: This is a synthetic concept image, not a site photograph, confirmed viewpoint, accessibility result, operating evidence or staffing commitment.

zh.title: 沿普通—验证—故障—恢复读一次连续旅程
zh.question: 失败发生后，谁停、谁接管、如何恢复？
zh.answer: 物理停止优先于界面提示；人工接管、隔离和非 AI 绕行立即保住普通任务。只有恢复材料、居民确认、维护关闭和责任复核齐备，验证叠层才可重新候选。
zh.alt: 失败侧线与回写图：停止、人工接管、隔离、普通任务继续、恢复验收和证据回写。
zh.limit: 合成回放 PASS 只证明文件合同可重放；现实事故、恢复时长、班次、场所验收与 GO 决定均为 0 或 unknown。

en.title: Follow one ordinary–proof–failure–recovery journey
en.question: After failure, who stops, who takes over and what permits recovery?
en.answer: Physical stop precedes interface messaging. Staffed takeover, isolation and a non-AI bypass preserve the ordinary task. Proof may become a candidate again only after restoration evidence, resident confirmation, maintenance closure and duty review exist.
en.alt: Failure-siding and writeback diagram showing stop, staffed takeover, isolation, ordinary-task continuity, restoration acceptance and evidence writeback.
en.limit: A synthetic replay PASS proves only that file contracts can be replayed. Real incidents, recovery duration, rosters, site acceptance and GO decisions remain 0 or unknown.

zh.title: 把概念交给真实资料与专业 NO-GO
zh.question: 哪些内容必须被替换，谁有权拒绝？
zh.answer: D01—D08 真实资料替换临时几何、类型占位与未核验来源；H01—H07 专业复算、核验责任并可修改、拒绝或删除概念。重大缺口、权利不清或普通权利受损时保持 NO-GO。
zh.alt: 评审收束与专业交接总图：一概念、三原型、一内核、六任务、八类资料、七专业与 NO-GO。
zh.limit: 文件、图件、机器检查、PR 审查或合并均不构成规划判断、专业责任接受、现场批准、运营成绩或权利许可。

en.title: Hand the concept to real inputs and professional NO-GO
en.question: What must be replaced, and who may reject the concept?
en.answer: D01–D08 real inputs replace provisional geometry, typed placeholders and unverified sources. H01–H07 disciplines recalculate, verify duties, and may revise, reject or delete the concept. Major gaps, unclear rights or harm to ordinary rights retain NO-GO.
en.alt: Review and professional handoff map: one concept, three prototypes, one kernel, six duties, eight inputs, seven disciplines and NO-GO.
en.limit: No file, drawing, machine check, PR review or merge creates a planning judgement, accepted professional duty, site approval, operating result or reuse licence.
